definitions.explanation: Used to add information that strengthens or supplements what was said before.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。しかも⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant is cheap. Moreover, it's delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。しかも⟦{努力家|どりょくか}→努力家：22284_doryokuka⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He's smart. What's more, he's hardworking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。しかも⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦な→な：noentry⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: I was late. And it was to an important meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧。しかも⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: This apartment is close to the station. What's more, the rent is cheap too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|さん}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。しかも⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{独学|どくがく}→独学：09601_dokugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{身|み}につけた→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: She can speak three languages. Moreover, she apparently learned all of them on her own.

notes:
USAGE: しかも adds emphasis to additional information. It typically introduces something surprising or noteworthy that reinforces the previous statement.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- しかも - moreover (adds emphasis, often positive or surprising)
- ⟦その{上|うえ}→そのうえ：00381_sonoue⟧ - on top of that, moreover
- ⟦{更|さら}に→更に：03817_sarani⟧ - furthermore, even more
- ⟦おまけに→おまけに：21779_omakeni⟧ - on top of that (often negative additional point)

POSITION: Typically appears at the beginning of a new sentence or clause.
